stated: The Conservative Party will continue with plans to end rough sleeping and prevent people from ending up on the streets, including delivering commitments under the Local Authority Housing Fund and reviewing temporary accommodation quality.

source.quote: We will continue with our plans to end rough sleeping and prevent people from ending up on the streets in the first place, after making significant progress over the last few years. We will deliver our commitments under the Local Authority Housing Fund and review the quality of temporary accommodation.

bearing_set.reason: The policy targets rough sleeping and temporary accommodation quality, and invokes the Local Authority Housing Fund — all of which directly affect the availability and adequacy of housing for people at the extreme end of unaffordability/unavailability, earning a real verdict on affordable housing stock and access.

Rough sleeping sits at the absolute bottom of the income-and-housing distribution; successfully housing rough sleepers and improving temporary accommodation quality narrows the gap between the most deprived and the rest, moving the bottom-end inequality indicator in a measurable direction.

membership_note: The primary bearing is O1 (housing supply and quality for the most vulnerable); O14 is a genuine cross-outcome effect because the policy is specifically targeted at the most materially deprived, with a concrete mechanism (securing housing for those with none) that narrows the gap at the bottom. Health spillovers (O3) and cohesion effects (O15) are real but incidental to the policy's mechanisms and do not independently clear the non-negligible bar here.
